deliverables.summary: Multi-layer defence-in-depth against indirect prompt injection. Trusted Instruction Hierarchy with 3 trust classes (SYS/DEV/USR). 7 defense layers (signature verify, origin provenance, length/type, regex scan, delimitation, scope check, SIGIL). 47 regex patterns open-source SIGIL-anchored. Tool-output sandboxing via <tool-output> XML delimiters. 7-vector threat model all mitigated. Zero external ML classifiers. Compliance: OWASP LLM01, MITRE ATLAS AML.T0051, NIST AI 600-1 GV-4, NCSC Secure AI, EU AI Act Art 15, JSP 936 §4.6.

Reference architecture for sovereign MCP server deployment. 3 deployment models (SUBPROCESS for Ring0 / SIDECAR for Ring1 / FEDERATED for Ring2). Ring-based firewall isolation + zero-trust mTLS with Ed25519 certs. WireGuard tunnel to Oracle UK-South BFT gateway. Port allocation 8100-9099 across rings. Liveness probes every 15s with auto-recovery (3-strike restart, quarantine, attestation suspended). 30 MCPs in production. Compliance: NCSC CAF C1/C2/C4, NIST SP 800-204D, JSP 440 Ch7, EU AI Act Art 15, SOC2 CC6.6.

Kill-switch + pause + graceful shutdown putting human owner back in the loop. 7-second hard kill (Touch ID → SIGTERM → SIGKILL → 4-pass cryptographic secret erase → SIGIL red-line). 30-second soft pause. 5-minute graceful shutdown. 5 local triggers (Touch ID, WebUI, voice, CLI, dead-man USB). 7 recovery modes (RESUME/RESTART/ROLLBACK/FORENSICS/QUARANTINE/KEY_ROTATION/OWNER_HANDOVER). 60-second encrypted snapshots with 30-day retention. 5 immutable red lines documented. Compliance: EU AI Act Art 14, UK AISI AI Management Essentials, NIST AI RMF GOVERN 1.3, ISO 42001 A.9, JSP 936 §5.4, NCSC CAF C2.
